$comment: The live /play event. Single source of truth for the countdown pill/banner (src/game/event-countdown.js), the in-world meetup experience layer (src/game/meetup-event.js: agenda drawer, go-live moments, synchronized fireworks, commemorative photo), AND the server-side souvenir grant (multiplayer/src/event-drop.js, which fetches this same file). Times are ISO-8601 UTC. agenda[].atMin is minutes after startsAt. Preview locally with ?meetup=now or ?meetup=<ISO> on /play.
name: $THREE First Holders Meetup
tagline: The first live gathering in the three.ws world. Drop in, hang out, win prizes.

souvenir.$comment: Free commemorative wearable granted once to every player in the world named by `link` between startsAt and endsAt. Must be an id in multiplayer/src/cosmetics-catalog.js with tier 'event' — the server refuses to grant anything else, so this field can never hand out a boutique item. Drop the field to run an event with no souvenir.
